info.title: Paseo Bridge API
info.description: REST commands and snapshots with recommended SSE observation. Prefer SSE for ongoing status/activity; clients without streaming support may poll agent and activity endpoints. Authentication, host/operation scopes and uncertainty rules apply to both modes. Local Unix-socket and central HTTPS clients use the same paths. Administrative operations are never exposed through HTTP.

get.summary: Get current agent state for polling or resynchronization
get.description:
For ongoing observation, prefer the SSE events endpoint. Clients without SSE support may poll this endpoint. Use an interval of at least 2 seconds, back off on transient failures and honor rate limits. Never resend a message to recover observation. Requires wait permission. A terminal result observes the agent, not a request-ID-correlated message completion. Idle does not reconcile an uncertain send.
Authorization operation scope: wait.

get.summary: Recommended: observe agent state using SSE
get.description:
Prefer SSE to repeated polling when supported. Requires wait permission; include=activity additionally requires activity permission. Named SSE events contain JSON matching AgentEvent. Initial connection sends a fresh snapshot. Comment heartbeats occur every 10 seconds; each connection lasts at most 60 seconds. Reconnect read-only with backoff and a shared overall deadline. Last-Event-ID does not promise replay: reconnect emits resync and a new snapshot; use activity queries to retrieve history and check its gap/epoch indicators. No durable event replay is promised. Stream errors are error events after HTTP headers. Agent idle is not proof of a particular message completion. Disconnecting never cancels work or resends messages. Browser consumers should use fetch streaming with Authorization headers, not tokens in URLs.
Authorization operation scope: wait.

200.description: SSE stream; event data models are described by AgentEvent.
